title: Off-center kernel squared sum
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\mathcal F$ be a nonempty family of subsets of the $n$ coordinates, and fix a sign vector $x$. The sum over all sign vectors $a$, excluding $a=x$, of the squared prescribed Fourier kernel evaluated at $(a,x)$ is $2^n/|\mathcal F|-1$.
hypotheses_covered: $\mathcal F$ is a nonempty family of subsets of the coordinate set
$x$ is a sign vector of length $n$
